sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Construct used in co-IP with MRAP2 in HEK293 cells (implies expression); no dedicated surface-expression or receptor-function assay (cAMP, radioligand binding) reported in the cited clips.
sites.rationale: MTNR1A is a GPCR with no signal peptide (UniProt P48039); the topology landmarks place residues 1–29 as extracellular and the C-terminus (residues 296–350) as intracellular. The N-terminus is therefore the sole extracellular terminus, making insert_after_residue=0 (prepend before M1) the unique topology-derived junction for an N-terminal tag. The prepend site sits 29 residues from the TM1 boundary (residue 30), well above the ≥3-residue minimum. Neither L1 nor L2 names a specific residue, so position_evidence is topology_derived rather than validated. Full-length MTNR1A cloned into pcDNA3.1(+) with a FLAG tag at the N-terminus; construct co-transfected with HA-MRAP2 into HEK293 cells for co-immunoprecipitation. No residue number is stated in either ledger line.

sources.claim: MTNR1A and MTNR1B were integrated into the pcDNA3.1(+) plasmid with a Flag protein tag at the N-terminus, while MRAP2 was cloned into the pcDNA3.1(+) plasmid with HA protein tag at the N-terminus.

literature_notes: Only two ledger lines are provided (L1, L2), both from the same paper (PMC12158745) and both describing the same N-terminal FLAG-tagged full-length MTNR1A construct. No residue number is stated in either clip, so the junction is derived from topology alone (prepend = insert_after_residue 0). MTNR1A has no annotated signal peptide, so the tag is not silently cleaved. The construct was used as a co-IP tool; no surface-flow-cytometry, ELISA, or functional (cAMP/binding) data for the tagged receptor are reported in the clips, hence validation_level is detected_only. No other ledger lines support additional sites (no ECL insertions, no C-terminal extracellular tag, no transposon/FP-fusion data).
